description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Banana is a high-fiber, low-protein, calcium-rich pellet food for tortoises. Composition: oats, maize, oat bran, beet pulp, calcium carbonate, dicalcium phosphate and turmeric, with banana aroma. Vitamins A, D3 and E are added, along with iron, copper, zinc, manganese, iodine and selenium. Of the three HabiStat Tortoise Food flavors, this is the lowest-protein variant.

This is a complementary food, not a replacement for fresh greens. The manufacturer recommends feeding it a couple of times a week as part of a varied diet, at 1-4% of the tortoise's body weight. Soak the pellets in warm water before feeding to soften them. Store in a cool, dark place.
It suits European, Russian and most other tortoise species. Learn how to set up a home for your tortoise in our tortoise terrarium guide.
